texts: After thirty years of carrying obligations, I retired last month, and for the first time felt my soul loosen, as if some ancient grip had finally let go of me.
soul set free
Let bondage end, O Lord; let the soul rise, light and unbound, beyond the round of births.
doha about the soul finally being free from all bondage
Write a doha about the moment when the soul is released from the long cycle of births and every knot of attachment, and stands free at last, with nothing left to bind it to this world.
doha with a churn and a moth about the soul breaking free of bondage
The moth leaves the flame and the churn stops turning; free of the wheel, the soul is gone beyond.
I watched a moth escape from a jar by the churn in our kitchen, and thought of how long I have felt trapped by the endless round of my own life and its repetitive troubles.
Please write a doha about the churn that turns endlessly, never finishing, like the cycle of birth and death, and the moth who finally breaks away, as the soul is liberated.
churn, moth, liberation
The cuckoo opens her throat and flies, uncaged by the long round of becoming; so the soul is free.
cuckoo, soul's freedom
Compose a doha about a cuckoo that sings of freedom from the bonds of this world, and the soul that finally breaks the cycle of birth and death and flies unfettered to its true home.
cuckoo doha about the soul being freed from the cycle of rebirth
The cuckoo in our yard has sung all spring, and listening to it I felt a longing for the kind of freedom where I never have to return to the same old struggles again.
The lion leaves the palace of his pride, the soul leaves the palace of the world, and both are free.
The lion tamer at the circus ended his career this week after thirty years; he said, standing in front of the old palace-like hall, that he felt finally free of a life that had owned him.
doha with a lion and a palace about the soul breaking free of this world's bondage
Write a doha about a lion pacing the grand halls of a palace, strong yet bound, and about the soul that is finally set free from the cycle of birth and every bond that held it.
lion, palace, soul liberated
Write a doha about a date palm that stands tall and drops its fruit, free of all weight, as the soul at last is released from the cycle of rebirth and rises free of every chain of attachment.
My grandmother, who has lived through such hardships, sat beneath the date palm on her last birthday and said she was ready to be free of all this coming and going.
date palm, soul released
date palm doha about release from the cycle of birth and death
The date palm sheds its fruit and rises bare; so the soul sheds all bondage and stands free.
doha with the sun and a beggar about freedom of the soul from all bondage

Compose a doha about a beggar who owns nothing and so is bound by nothing, and the sun that rises over his freedom, showing that the soul is liberated when it is no longer tied to anything of this world.
The sun rises on the beggar who owns nothing, and the soul, bound to nothing, is free as light.
A beggar who sleeps outside my building wakes with the sun, owns nothing and seems to belong to nobody, and I envy a freedom I have never had in my own tangled life.
sun, beggar, free soul
doha with thread and seed about breaking free from the bonds of this world
thread, seed, liberation
Please write a doha about the thread that binds the soul to the world and the seed that, once burnt, can never sprout again, so that the soul becomes free from the cycle of birth.
Every attachment in my life felt like a thread tied to my ankle, and one by one over the years I cut them, until I felt as though a seed of another life would never take root in me.
Snap the last thread, burn the last seed, and the soul walks out of the cycle at last.
doha about a weaver at the loom finishing his last weave, free of the cycle of birth
My uncle, a weaver at the loom all his life, finished his final weave and said now he is ready to be free of all this weaving, in every sense.
Write a doha about a weaver at his loom who finishes the last weave and leaves, and so the soul, finishing its final task, is released from the weaving of births and deaths.
The weaver leaves the loom at last, and the soul is free from the endless weaving of births.
weaver's loom, final release
moon doha about the soul slipping free from the cycle of birth like the moon from the night's veil
I watched the moon come out from behind the dark veil of night last night and felt, quite suddenly, that I too was emerging from some long confinement of the soul.
moon, soul unbound
Compose a doha about the moon that slips out from behind a dark veil, shining free and bright, and the soul that slips out from the bondage of repeated births and shines in its own freedom.
The moon steps free of the veil, and the soul steps free of the cycle, shining, unbound.
doha about the soul being released from the cycle of birth and death
The body is broken, the dust returns to dust, and the soul goes free of the round of birth.
After my grandfather's death, my grandmother said not with sorrow but with strange relief that he had finally been let out of the long round of coming and going.
I want a doha about the moment the soul gets free of the long cycle of birth and death, when all the knots of desire and attachment are cut and nothing remains to bind it to this world again.
release from birth and death
mosque, soul's release
Praying in the mosque on the last day of fasting, I felt a deep lightness, as though some chain I had been dragging for years had just fallen off my soul.
Please write a doha about a man in a mosque who prays to be released not from poverty or sorrow but from the cycle of births and the bondage of this world, so that his soul may be free.
In the mosque he bows, not for bread or wealth, but to be unbound from the wheel of the world.
doha with a mosque about wanting freedom of the soul, not riches
lock and grindstone doha about the soul being freed from the world's bondage
I felt locked in a life that ground me down daily like a grindstone, until one day I walked out of the job and the marriage, and felt my soul breathe again.
Write a doha about a lock that keeps the soul prisoner and a grindstone that grinds it through repeated births, until the Lord's grace breaks the lock and the soul walks free.
lock, grindstone, freedom
The grindstone grinds, the lock holds fast, and the soul at last goes free, unbound.
Please write a doha about the touchstone that tests the soul through many births until it is pure enough to be released, and the soul that finally passes and steps out of the cycle to freedom.
touchstone, soul's liberation
Many times the touchstone tested me, and now at last the knot of birth is cut.
After failing the same spiritual test in my life again and again like metal on a touchstone, I finally let go of the thing that held me, and felt a freedom I have no name for.
touchstone doha about passing the final test and being freed from rebirth
cuckoo, moon, freedom
On a spring night, with a cuckoo calling and the moon high, I felt as though I could step out of my skin and be free of all that had weighed on my soul.
The cuckoo calls, the moon looks on, and the soul unlocks its chain and flies.
Compose a doha about a cuckoo singing under the moon, free from the world's bondage, and the soul that likewise breaks out of the long cycle of births and rises into liberation.
cuckoo and moon doha about the soul's release from bondage
The crow no longer circles, the thorn no longer pricks; the soul has slipped out of the cycle.
Write a doha about a crow that rises beyond a thorn bush and into open sky, as the soul rises from the briars of repeated births into the open freedom of liberation.
crow, thorn, soul released
crow and thorn doha - the soul breaking free of the cycle of births
A crow freed itself from the thorn hedge outside my window this morning, and I thought of how I have been tangled in the same worries for years and long to escape.
No more the rounds of birth and death, no more the grip of me and mine; the soul is free.
freedom from bondage
I would like a doha about the final release of the soul from the long cycle of birth and death, when all attachments are cut and nothing remains of the bondage that held it to this world.
doha about the soul being free from birth and death forever
My teacher said the aim of all practice is to become so light and unattached that you are never again pulled back into the same cycle of struggle, and that image has stayed with me.
Write a doha about a blind man who walks through sandalwood fragrance and feels freedom from all weight, as the soul sheds its bonds and is released from the cycle of birth and death.
sandalwood and blind man doha about the soul becoming free
The blind man smells sandalwood and knows he is free, though he has never seen the shore of liberation.
sandalwood, blind man, freedom
My blind friend, walking through the sandalwood lane, said he felt for a moment unbound from every limit of the body, and that this was how he imagined being set free would feel.
bondage broken, soul free
doha about breaking free of attachment and becoming liberated
Please write a doha about the soul bound by a thousand ties to this world, and about the day the Lord cuts them all, so that it is free of every bond, and the cycle of rebirth ends.
A thousand ties held the soul; one by one the Lord has loosened them, and now it is free.
It took me a decade of therapy and letting go, but last week I realised that I am no longer bound by the things that used to own me, and I wept for joy.
When the cuckoo sang at dawn after my long illness ended, I sat up in bed and felt as if the soul inside me had been let out of a very small room.
cuckoo, soul's release
Cuckoo, sing the song of those who are free, whom birth and death can no longer hold.
Please write a doha about a cuckoo singing over the soul that has ended its long wandering through births and found release, with nothing left to bind it to this world.
cuckoo doha about the soul being freed at last from rebirth
Free at last, the soul looks back and smiles at the long road of births it no longer walks.
doha about the soul finally leaving the cycle of birth and death behind
freedom, no more births
I want a doha about the soul that has traveled through countless births and at last is released, so that it will never again be pulled back into the sorrow and bondage of this world.
My grandmother, in her final weeks, said she was not afraid because she felt she would not have to come back to all this again, and that thought made her serene.
Write a doha about a cleric who tells the faithful that cotton robes and loud prayers will free them, while the Lord's grace alone cuts the soul loose from the cycle of birth and bondage.
The cleric wraps in cotton and promises release, yet only the Lord's hand unbinds the soul.
cotton and cleric doha about true freedom of the soul, not from rituals
cotton, cleric, true freedom
A cleric in our town sells promises of release for a fee and wears fine cotton, but the real freedom I have felt came only after I let go of my bitterness.
doha about the soul being truly free at last
Compose a doha about the soul that has been bound through many lives by desire and ignorance, and that finally stands free, light and unattached, in the grace of the Lord.
After a lifetime of anxiety about what others thought of me, a quiet morning came when I felt entirely free of it, and I understood what the old saints mean by release.
Free, free, the soul is free, no longer owned by desire or by the dread of returning.
soul finally free
Write a doha about a beggar working at a grindstone who owns nothing, and who is nonetheless free in a way the rich are not, as the soul is free when it is released from all bondage.
The grindstone turns, the beggar sings, and he is freer than a king who is bound to his wealth.
grindstone, beggar, soul free
grindstone and beggar doha - freedom of the soul from worldly bonds
The beggar who grinds spice on a grindstone at the corner owns nothing and has no worries, and compared with him my life full of loans and obligations feels like a cell.
rainbird, soul released
After the long drought, when the first rain finally came, I watched the rainbird drink and felt that some old tightness in my chest and soul had been released at last.
rainbird doha about the soul's freedom from bondage at last
The rainbird drinks at last and is free of thirst; so the soul is free of its long wandering.
Please write a doha about a rainbird that has waited so long for the rain and drinks freely at last, as the soul, released from the cycle of birth and bondage, drinks the nectar of freedom.
The rainbird's thirst is over, the soul's chains are cut, and both are free beneath the rain.
The day my loan was cleared and the long worry ended, I heard a rainbird in the garden and felt as though a tight band around my soul had been cut.
rainbird doha about being set free from bondage like the rain freeing the earth
Compose a doha about a rainbird whose long thirst is quenched, and the soul that is quenched in the same way when it is released from the cycle of birth and death into freedom.
rainbird, freedom
The cleric crosses on his boat of rules, but the soul that is truly free needs no boat to cross.
cleric, boat, true release
A cleric offered to take us across to salvation in his boat of rules and fees, but my mother said that real release comes from within, not from anyone's list.
Write a doha about a cleric who rows his boat of rules toward liberation and a seeker who simply lets go of all bondage, and finds himself on the far shore without a boat.
cleric and boat doha - real freedom of the soul is not bought by rules
doha on the soul becoming free from all bondage forever
Unbound, unburdened, unborn again no more: the soul is gone beyond the round.
When my father died after a long suffering, our family elder said he had finally been freed, and as I looked at the stillness in his face I thought he was right.
Please write a doha about the soul that, through the Lord's grace, is released from the cycle of birth and death, and is free forever from every bond of desire, sorrow and attachment.
soul released forever
My shadow stretched across the road as I walked out of the old office for the last time, and I felt as though something had been cut loose from my soul along with it.
The shadow falls away at noon, and the soul, freed from its body, is light as light.
shadow doha about the soul being freed from the cycle of rebirth
shadow, soul free
Write a doha about a shadow that follows the soul through many lives and finally falls away, leaving the soul free, light and unattached, released from every bond of the world.
After a decade of caring for a sick parent, I felt on her passing a strange mingled grief and release, as though we both had been let out of something very long.
The long round of coming and going ends today; the soul has found its freedom.
doha about the soul finally being set free from this world's bondage
final freedom of the soul
I would like a doha about how the soul is released from the long cycle of birth and death when the Lord's grace frees it from the bonds of desire, and how this is the final goal of every life.
The soul flies out of the long bondage, and nothing remains of the cycle that held it so long.
release from bondage
doha on the soul becoming free and going beyond the cycle of rebirth
My grandmother's last words were that she felt free, unburdened, and that she would not return, and the whole family sat in awe of her calm.
Compose a doha about the soul that is free from the cycle of repeated births at last, having cut its desires and ties, and rests in the Lord with nothing left to bind it to the world.
market and snake doha about the soul shedding its skin and becoming free
Write a doha about a snake that sheds its skin in the market and moves on lightly, as the soul sheds the bonds of attachment and the cycle of births to become free forever.
market, snake, soul's freedom
In the market the snake sheds its old skin and slips away; the soul sheds the world and goes free.
I saw a snake shed its skin behind my shop in the market and thought how I wished I could slip out of my old life as easily and leave it behind.
lamp doha about the soul being free from bondage like light escaping the dark
lamp, soul unbound
When I lit the lamp the night my divorce was final, I felt not grief but a strange lightness, as if the soul inside me had been let out of a cramped place.
The lamp burns clean, the soul is free, and the night of bondage ends.
Compose a doha about a lamp that drives away the darkness of ignorance and burns away the bonds of attachment, leaving the soul free at last from the cycle of births and deaths.
The rainbird sings; the soul is free of every cycle that bound it to the earth.
rainbird doha about the soul being set free for good
rainbird, freedom
After my long recovery I sat on the veranda listening to a rainbird, and for the first time in years I felt entirely unbound, as if my soul had been uncorked.
Please write a doha about a rainbird calling in the rain, free of the sorrows of the earth, and the soul that is similarly released from the cycle of birth and death into boundless freedom.
The skeleton at the medical museum made me think of how the body, like a bundle, will one day fall, and how I hope my cuckoo-loving soul will walk out into freedom.
skeleton and cuckoo doha about the soul leaving the body and becoming free
skeleton, cuckoo, soul freed
The skeleton stays on the ground and the cuckoo's song goes on; the soul has left, and is free.
Write a doha about a skeleton left behind and a cuckoo that sings on, showing that the soul has left the body and has been released from the cycle of birth, free in the Lord.
The door of bondage opens at last, and the soul walks out into the freedom of the Lord.
door doha about the soul finally getting out of the cycle of rebirth
Please write a doha about a door that opens at last for the soul that has been shut in the cycle of births, so that it walks out into the open freedom of the Lord, never to return.
door, soul's release
After months of being stuck in a bad situation, I finally walked through a door into a new life and felt what I can only call the freedom of my soul.
short doha on release from the cycle of birth and death
Gone is the weight of becoming, gone the fear of return; the soul breathes in freedom.
free of rebirth
Write a doha about a soul that has been released from the long cycle of birth and death by the Lord's grace, and that lives in freedom, untouched by any desire or any return to this world.
When my uncle finally gave up his addiction after twenty years, he said he felt reborn and free of something that had followed him through his whole life.
The fly is caught in sand-sticky honey, but the soul tears itself loose and is free.
Write a doha about a fly stuck in a trap and a field of sand that holds no footprint, and about the soul that frees itself from the sticky bonds of the world and from the cycle of births.
Watching a fly struggle in a sticky trap on a sand-colored wall, I felt my own long entanglement in worries and wished for the moment it would finally break free.
fly and sand doha about the soul getting free of the world's trap
fly, sand, soul free

Compose a doha about a moneylender who has bound men with debts, and a well where all that he has taken falls away, showing that the soul is finally released from every debt and from the cycle of rebirth.
moneylender and well doha - the soul being cleared of every debt and set free
The moneylender gave up his business after a visit to the old water well, saying he felt for the first time free of the weight he had been carrying for decades.
moneylender, well, freedom
The moneylender's ledger burns, the well runs clear, and the soul walks out free of all debt.
When the moneylender finally came to tear up the debts our family had carried for decades, my father sat down and wept, saying he felt his soul had been let go.
moneylender doha about being freed from a debt of lifetimes
Please write a doha about a moneylender who holds the soul in debt from life to life, until the Lord's grace cancels all and the soul is released from the cycle, free of every claim.
The moneylender cancels the last debt and the soul walks free, owing nothing to the world.
moneylender, debts erased, freedom
I want a doha about the soul that has been wandering through lives, bound by desires, and at last cuts all of them and is free to rest in the Lord forever, with no further births to endure.
My grandfather, during his last years, gave away all he had and said that he was getting ready to leave this world without taking a single bond with him.
Cut the bond of desire, cut the bond of fear, and the soul goes free of the round of births.
no more births
doha about the soul going free by cutting all its desires
Please write a doha about a moth that dashes into the flame and is free of its body, as the soul, burnt free of desire, is released from the cycle of births and goes beyond.
moth, soul's freedom
The moth gives itself to the flame and is free; so the soul, burnt of its desires, goes beyond.
I watched a moth circle the porch light until it dropped, and in an odd way I envied its release from the long circling that my own mind seems to be stuck in.
moth doha about the soul being freed by burning off all attachments
crow doha about the soul going free from the world, like a crow leaving its nest
The crow that nested outside my window left this spring, and I realised I too am ready to leave behind the long cycle of striving and belong to something larger.
Compose a doha about a crow that flies free of its nest and rises into the open sky, as the soul rises free of the cycle of rebirth and bondage into the Lord's boundless freedom.
The crow leaves its nest and the soul leaves the world, and the sky has no more walls.
crow, soul released
forest and bridge doha about crossing over to freedom from this world's bondage
forest, bridge, liberation
Write a doha about a forest of desires and a bridge over the sorrow of births, and the soul that crosses safely to the far shore and is released from the cycle forever.
After a long and tangled phase of my life, like walking through a forest, I finally found a bridge in the form of a new job and crossed it feeling free.
Through the forest of desire, over the bridge of grace, the soul crosses into freedom.
doha on the soul crossing beyond birth and death into freedom
Please write a doha about the soul that has crossed beyond the cycle of birth and death into a freedom with no trace of return, through the grace of the Lord and its own surrender.
beyond birth and death
Beyond the round of coming and going lies the open freedom where no soul is born again.
When my meditation teacher said that freedom is not a place you go but a weight you drop, I felt something fall from my shoulders that I had carried all my life.
shroud, forehead mark, release
Before my uncle's cremation, the family put a mark on his forehead and wrapped him in a shroud, and I felt that he had been set free from a long hard life.
The shroud is wrapped, the forehead mark is made, and the soul has slipped its body and is free.
Write a doha about a shroud wrapped around a body and a mark on the forehead, and the soul that leaves it all behind, released from the cycle of births and free forever.
shroud and forehead mark doha about the soul being free after death
My neighbour spent years training a musk deer for the zoo, and when it was finally released into the hills, she said she felt a freedom she had not known for her own soul.
The musk deer runs free in the hills, and the soul runs free of the long bondage of births.
Compose a doha about a musk deer that wanders the hills free of every bond, and the soul that likewise breaks the cycle of birth and rebirth and moves in the open freedom of the Lord.
musk deer doha about the soul being released from the cycle of births
musk deer, soul free
When the last desire dies, the last birth ends, and the soul is free.
doha about the soul reaching final freedom from rebirth
Write a doha about the moment when all the longings of the soul are quiet, all debts of action are cleared, and the soul is released from the round of births to rest forever in the Lord.
My wife and I finished paying off our last obligation this week, and sitting together in the quiet, we both felt a strange lightness of the soul.
last desire gone, free
Free of the world, free of birth, free of fear: the soul is released at last.
My cousin, after years of being trapped in a toxic situation, finally walked away last week, and he looked ten years younger, as if his soul had been unchained.
I would like a doha about the soul's release from the long wheel of births, a freedom beyond sorrow and desire in which the soul rests unbound in the Lord, never to be born again.
soul free of birth
doha about the final freedom of the soul from this world
Write a doha about a fire that burns away the bonds of the soul, destroying every attachment and every desire, so that the soul is free of the cycle of birth and death forever.
The fire burns the bonds of desire, and the soul steps out of it free and bright.
fire doha about burning off all attachments and being set free
fire, soul's liberation
After the fire at our shop burned everything we owned, my father said, with an odd calm, that he had never felt so free, as though the bonds of years had burnt away too.
Please write a doha about a tree whose roots are in the earth and a crow that rises free from its branches, so that the soul, released from the cycle of births, rises free of the earth.
The crow rises from the tree and the soul from the world, and the roots of bondage are cut.
A crow rose out of the old tree in our yard as I stood there on my last day before retirement, and I felt as though I too was rising free of something.
tree and crow doha about the soul going free from this world
tree, crow, liberation
